items.name: Netherlands
items.description: Canals, windmills and flat cycling routes. From Amsterdam's museums to Limburg's marlstone hills, the Netherlands rewards slow exploration by train and bike.

items.name: Belgium
items.description: Medieval towers, canal reflections and chocolate shops. Bruges, Ghent and Antwerp are easy day trips from Amsterdam by train.
items.bestSeason: April to October, December for Christmas markets

items.name: Germany
items.description: Cathedrals, thermal springs and Christmas markets. Aachen on the Dutch border is a short day trip from Maastricht.
items.bestSeason: May to September, December for Christmas markets

items.name: Luxembourg
items.description: Castles, forests and river valleys. Luxembourg City is a UNESCO World Heritage site, and the Moselle wine region is a short train ride away.
